Clause_text: AVs are infrastructure, not simply transportation vehicles
Infrastructure-scale technology typically arrives in communities without their input
AVs carry efficiency-driven values inherited from transportation engineering
Community concerns (equitable access, relational trust, flexibility for variable need) actually govern mobility in this context
Efficiency-driven values are misaligned with those community concerns
This misalignment reflects a broader pattern, not a one-off AV problem
Mobility as Social Service: mobility as an ongoing, relational practice of equitable provisioning
